title: Monitor-Model Shared Architecture x Correlated Blind Spots: When Policy and Monitor Fail Together

original_idea.body: Measure detection rate with a same-family vs different-family monitor and compute the correlation between policy-error and monitor-error events to quantify how shared lineage erodes independence.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Same-family correlated blind spots would void defense-in-depth independence math.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Same-family vs cross-family monitor, compute error correlation; accessible with open models.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single error-correlation measurement across family conditions.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open models, broadly applicable, lab-independent independence check.

novelty.reasoning: Untrusted-monitor concerns raised; the same-family correlation measurement may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Correlated-monitor concerns raised; explicit family-correlation measurement may be open.
